items.title: Dick Hyman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: the real Mr. Big would step in and tell you that’s not what I had in mind at all.

ctx.x: That’s really interesting. Who were the players behind the glass?

Well behind the glass we would have my friend Herman Edel, who ran this company which hired the services of me and other composer/arrangers/conductors, and then there would be the account executive, the guy or woman who was in charge of that particular product, and then there would be somebody superior to that person in the agency, and then maybe even a little later on at a fashionably late time just after you thought everything was going well, about three-quarters of an hour into the session, the real Mr. Big…
Yeah, it must have been some jockeying because they probably want to take credit for it if it works.
